notes.title: Workaround for NW.js Profile Error
notes.content:
Hello! This minor issue may affect a small subset users upon startup of [i]Storynth[/i]. A more formal fix for the issue is being investigated; in the interim, a workaround has been provided.

[b][u]Am I affected? How does the issue present?[/u][/b]
Either just before or as the title screen for [i]Storynth[/i] appears, users may see a popup alerting them that their profile is associated with a version of NW.js that is incompatible with the game. If the user closes this popup, [i]Storynth[/i] will run normally, and its functionality will not be affected in any way.

[b][u]How do I fix it?[/u][/b]
[olist]
[*]Navigate to C:\\Users\\[user name here]\\AppData\\Local\\User Data\\Default
[*]Select the "Web Data" and "Web Data-journal" files.
[*]Delete both.
[*]Start [i]Storynth[/i].
[/olist]
[b][u]Why does this work?[/u][/b]
In short, the "Web Data" files do not typically refresh every time the game is started, as [i]Storynth[/i] utilizes no Web-based features. When the game is restarted after deleting the duo of files, they are automatically re-generated in their previous directory with consideration for the NW.js version change.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2: Alternate Costumes!
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 1.0.2 is out now![/h2]

[h3]New Feature: Alternate Costumes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Alternate costumes are now available for all party members! They can be accessed after completing the main story by visiting the Trial By Combat tent in Lykoria. Stand in front of the wardrobe and select the character whose outfit you'd like to change!
[*] [b]Note:[/b] If it's your first time visiting the wardrobe, the Trial By Combat's operator will offer an explanation of its function. After he speaks, step away from the wardrobe and re-approach its tile to use it as normal.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes & Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] The color of Zorvus' hat is now consistent across all of its appearances.
[*] A spacing error in the credits has been corrected.
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Feature: Alternate Costumes
notes.content:
[h2]Alternate costumes are coming![/h2]

Alternate costumes will be available soon for use during post-story content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37265464/5703ebd22c68164b2d7377fc1fb23ae3637f100a.png[/img]

Each character's alternate costume appears within combat encounters as well as the overworld. Alternate costume support for post-game cutscenes is still in progress.

Upon release, the option to change a character’s appearance will be accessible via a wardrobe within the Trial By Combat's tent.

notes.title: First Patch: 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]A minor update has been released![/h2]

This patch resolves two event flow issues and partially resolves a performance issue; further investigation is being done into the latter.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from returning to Merkalet via the entrance to Whispering Glade
[*] Fixed a bug in which the player could enter Levtarin's house in the nighttime version of Dusklight
[*] Changed lighting effects in certain parts of Thunderfall Canyon to improve performance
[*] Added travel confirmation messages when going to/from Merkalet and Whispering Glade
[/list]

notes.title: Storynth is Now Available!
notes.content:
[i]Storynth[/i] is now available for purchase on Steam!

[h1]What's in the Game?[/h1]
[list]
[*] 4+ hours of main story content
[*] Post-game activities and unlockables
[*] Five playable characters, each with a specialized set of skills
[*] Over 60 pieces of music
[*] More than 20 in-game achievements to hunt down
[*] 9 dungeons, 7 fast-travel points, and 5 towns
[/list]

[h1]Have Something to Contribute?[/h1]

If you've found a bug or otherwise have something you'd like to discuss, you can leave a message about it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1278040/discussions/]here[/url].

Enjoy your adventures in the Storynth!
